context:
Goal: get a draft run, and then lint, on #3188 so it can be handed in.
Problem (rule): #3188 read dirty on GitHub against base b600c126. A read-only check at 14:48 CST found a real textual conflict, not a GitHub fault: both #3188 (head 486ea488) and #3186 conflict with main (685fa1631) in one place, docs/debts/notes.md after base line 2148, where main added 3 lines and each PR adds its own. The lane's local trial merge looked clean because .gitattributes line 7 sets docs/debts/notes.md to merge=union, which joins the two inserts locally; GitHub ignores that merge driver and reads them as a conflict (the lane's reading; the read-only check's plain 3-way merge also found 1 conflict per PR). The real merge commit clears it for GitHub. So a plain merge of main into #3188, with the notes.md lines of both sides kept, is the fix. Your order allowed one extra merge per draft and #3188 used it, so this one needs your word.
Based on (measured): REST reads at 14:43 CST show dirty, base sha b600c126, no workflow run on head 486ea488; and the conflict check above.
Departs from: your order — one more merge of main into #3188.
#3186 conflicts the same way; its extra merge is unspent, so the lane resolves it now without asking. Both PRs insert at the same line of notes.md, so the second to merge conflicts again.
holds: Lint and hand-in of #3188 wait on this answer.
